tagline: AB Labs Skincare: peptide serums for skin that looks firmer, smoother and brighter.

products.name: Copper Peptide Serum
products.summary: Our bestseller. Copper peptides to help skin look firmer, smoother and more even.
products.best_for: Dull or tired-looking skin, loss of firmness, uneven texture
products.how_to_use: 2 to 3 drops on clean skin each evening, before moisturiser. Don't use in the same routine as strong acids or vitamin C. Use those in the morning instead.

products.name: Multi-Peptide Firming Serum
products.summary: A blend of signal peptides to reduce the look of fine lines and help skin feel bouncier.
products.best_for: Early fine lines, skin that feels less bouncy
products.how_to_use: 2 to 3 drops morning and/or evening on clean skin, before moisturiser and SPF.

products.name: Expression Line Serum
products.summary: Targets the areas you move most (forehead, between the brows, around the eyes) to soften the look of expression lines.
products.best_for: Forehead lines, frown lines, crow's feet
products.how_to_use: Press a small amount into expression lines morning and evening, before moisturiser.

products.name: Peptide Eye Cream
products.summary: A light eye cream to reduce the look of puffiness and fine lines around the eyes.
products.best_for: Puffy or tired-looking eyes, fine lines around the eyes
products.how_to_use: Tap a rice-grain amount around the eye area morning and evening.

products.name: Full Peptide Routine (all 4)
products.summary: All four products together. Saves £23 compared with buying them separately.
products.best_for: Anyone who wants the complete routine, or gifts
products.how_to_use: Morning: firming serum, expression serum, eye cream, moisturiser, SPF. Evening: copper serum, expression serum, eye cream, moisturiser.
